extensionDescription.message: Save Wikipedia articles to read on Wikipedia Web, iOS, and Android apps

commandDescription.message: Choose a reading list for the current page

createList.description: Create a reading list button or tutorial heading.

updateList.description: Update a reading list button or tutorial heading.

shareIntro.message: Share the current browser store listing:

viewList.description: Tutorial heading for opening a list.

tutorialViewList.message: Open a reading list to browse its saved articles or view the summary of a saved article.
tutorialViewList.description: Tutorial explanation of viewing a list.

tutorialCreateList.message: Create a new reading list with a name and optional description.
tutorialCreateList.description: Tutorial explanation of creating a list.

tutorialUpdateList.message: Pick a list and edit its name or description.
tutorialUpdateList.description: Tutorial explanation of updating a list.

deleteList.description: Tutorial heading for deleting a list.

tutorialDeleteList.message: Delete a reading list, with confirmation.
tutorialDeleteList.description: Tutorial explanation of deleting a list.

tutorialExport.message: Export all reading lists or the currently open list as JSON.

saveRemoveArticle.description: Tutorial heading for saving and removing.

tutorialSaveRemove.message: On the overview, click a list row to save the current page. Saved icons remove articles from lists.
tutorialSaveRemove.description: Tutorial explanation of saving and removing.

moveArticle.description: Tutorial heading for moving an article.

tutorialMoveArticle.message: In a list, move an article into another reading list.
tutorialMoveArticle.description: Tutorial explanation of moving an article.

shareText.message: Check out Wikipedia Reading Lists Enhanced

defaultList.description: Badge for the default reading list.

selectDelete.message: Select a reading list to delete.

selectUpdate.message: Select a reading list to update.

noSummary.message: No summary is available for this article.

pageNotSaved.message: Page is not saved in this reading list.

checkingSaved.description: Checking which lists contain this article.

pageAccessError.message: Unable to access this page. Refresh the page and try again, and check the extension's site permissions.

enableSync.message: Enable syncing on your Wikipedia app to begin saving articles

entryLimitExceeded_one.message: Article cannot be saved. You have reached the limit of $1 article per list

entryLimitExceeded_other.message: Article cannot be saved. You have reached the limit of $1 articles per list
entryLimitExceeded_other.description: $1 is the maximum number of articles; other plural category.

moveSuccess.description: $1 is the article title and $2 is the destination list name.

removeSuccess.description: $1 is the article title and $2 is the reading list name.

unsupportedPage.message: This extension only works on supported Wikipedia and Wikivoyage article pages.

exportRetry.message: Wikimedia rate limit reached. Retry delay: $1 s. Lists completed: $2 / $3.
exportRetry.description: $1 is seconds to retry, $2 completed lists, $3 total lists.

exportInProgress.message: An export is already in progress.

exportUnsupportedOrigin.description: The requested export website is unsupported.
